rule: L=min across eligible scenario-H cells of landscape q05; U=max of landscape q95. Retain L<0.95 and U>0.05. Near-one if L>=0.95; near-zero if U<=0.05.
H_domain: All stored eligible model H levels, not the restricted empirical bird domain
boundary_method: Partial-order bounds from occupancy increasing with half-distance and decreasing with r; no smooth surface interpolation
plot_support: Mask outside convex hull of the 128 profiles; within-hull unresolved regions are hatched
scope: Candidate-domain assessment only. No domain adoption, new LHS points or new model computations authorised by this job.
